command:
mkdir -p out/r36
python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/r36-venv"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/r36-venv/bin/python" -m pip install 'pytest==9.0.2'
export PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1
export PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/runtime"
cd agent
set +e
"$RUNNER_TEMP/r36-venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q tests/test_journey_failure_modes.py --junitxml="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/verifier.xml" > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/verifier.log" 2>&1
verifier=$?
"$RUNNER_TEMP/r36-venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q 'tests/test_native_service_adapter.py::test_product_canonical_native_lifecycle_is_collected_but_fixture_is_inadmissible' 'tests/test_native_service_adapter.py::test_fixture_cannot_be_promoted_by_editing_scope_and_authentication' --junitxml="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/native.xml" > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/native.log" 2>&1
native=$?
"$RUNNER_TEMP/r36-venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q 'tests/test_native_service_adapter.py::test_structural_validator_rejects_mutated_native_fields[path14-self-hosted-RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT]' --junitxml="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/self-hosted.xml" > "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/self-hosted.log" 2>&1
self_hosted=$?
printf 'verifier=%s\nnative=%s\nself_hosted=%s\n' "$verifier" "$native" "$self_hosted" | tee "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/inner-exits.txt"
cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/r36/"*.log
[ "$verifier" -eq 0 ] && [ "$native" -eq 0 ] && [ "$self_hosted" -eq 0 ]
